informal_statement: Normalized cap area tends to infinity as the angle increases to pi.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At MorgansArcFunction.lean:188-211, the source contract is `lemma area_tendsto_atTop : Tendsto area (𝓝[<] π) atTop`. The unit-chord normalized area and arc length are constructed on 0 < theta < pi. The inverse is used geometrically only at positive area; its explicit totalization is not confused with an inverse outside that domain.
